title: Build with Microsoft Foundry · Level 3
slo: Identify the Foundry capabilities used to build AI applications and agents.

exercises.question_text: Which sources can a Foundry IQ knowledge base combine? Select all that apply.

options.rationale: Azure Blob Storage is a supported knowledge source. It can be combined with other sources.
SharePoint is a supported Foundry IQ source. It can contribute organization content.
OneLake can be included in a Foundry IQ knowledge base. Foundry IQ supports multi-source knowledge.
Azure Vision is an image-analysis service. It is not a listed knowledge-base source.
options.better_fit: Choose this when an application needs image analysis.

feedback.intrinsic: The needed source would not be connected.
feedback.instructional: Use supported data sources such as Blob Storage, SharePoint, OneLake, or public web data.

exercises.explanation: Correct. Foundry IQ can combine these organization sources.

options.text: A platform for building and managing AI apps and agents
options.rationale: Microsoft Foundry is a unified Azure platform for AI applications and agents. It brings together lifecycle capabilities such as models, governance, and monitoring.

options.text: An Azure resource that provides platform capabilities
options.rationale: A Foundry resource is a narrower Azure component. It is not the overall Microsoft Foundry platform.
options.better_fit: Use this description when defining a Foundry resource.

feedback.instructional: Microsoft Foundry is the broader platform.

options.text: A workspace inside a Foundry resource
options.rationale: A Foundry project is a workspace within a resource. It does not describe the complete platform.
options.better_fit: Use this description when defining a Foundry project.

feedback.intrinsic: This selects the wrong organizational level.
feedback.instructional: A project is a workspace; Foundry is the platform.

options.text: A service used only to store datasets
options.rationale: Foundry supports far more than dataset storage. It supports building, deploying, governing, and managing AI solutions.
options.better_fit: This would fit a data-storage-only service.

feedback.instructional: Foundry supports the AI application lifecycle.

exercises.explanation: Correct. Foundry is the unified Azure platform for AI applications and agents.

exercises.question_text: Foundry supports models from first-party, partner, and open-source sources.

feedback_for_incorrect.instructional: Foundry includes first-party, partner, and open-source models.

exercises.explanation: Correct. The catalog includes all three source categories.

exercises.question_text: Azure Language can summarize text, classify information, and extract key phrases.

feedback_for_incorrect.intrinsic: A useful language capability may be overlooked.
feedback_for_incorrect.instructional: Azure Language supports summarization, classification, and key-phrase extraction.

exercises.explanation: Correct. These are Azure Language capabilities.

exercises.question_text: Foundry IQ returns only information the user is ___ to see.

parts.text: Foundry IQ returns only information the user is

feedback_for_incorrect.intrinsic: The required access control is not expressed.
feedback_for_incorrect.instructional: Foundry IQ returns only authorized results.

exercises.explanation: Authorization determines whether a user may see returned information.

exercises.question_text: What can an AI agent do?

options.text: Reason, call tools, use data, and automate workflows
options.rationale: An AI agent is task-oriented and reasons over input. It can use data, call tools, and automate work.
Speech conversion is performed by Azure Speech. Agents coordinate broader task workflows.
options.better_fit: Use this description for Azure Speech.

feedback.instructional: Agents can call tools and automate workflows.

options.rationale: Foundry IQ provides knowledge grounding. An agent can use that knowledge while also reasoning and acting.
options.better_fit: Use this description for a knowledge retrieval layer.

feedback.intrinsic: This reduces an agent to retrieval.
feedback.instructional: Agents can use knowledge as part of a workflow.

options.rationale: Model hosting makes a model available. An agent is the system that coordinates task execution.
options.better_fit: Use this description for model-hosting capability.

feedback.instructional: Hosting and agent behavior are distinct.

exercises.explanation: Correct. Agents reason, use data, call tools, and automate work.

exercises.question_text: A product manager must compare models for a regulated application, deploy one under controls, and address safety. Which capabilities fit? Select all that apply.

options.rationale: The catalog supports comparing model alternatives. It directly supports the selection decision.
Governance supports controlled deployment. That addresses the regulated-release requirement.
Safety support addresses the stated risk requirement. It is relevant to a regulated AI release.
Azure Speech converts between speech and text. It does not evaluate models or govern deployment.
options.better_fit: Choose this when the application needs voice input or output.

feedback.intrinsic: The governance and safety needs remain unmet.
feedback.instructional: Use catalog, governance, and safety capabilities here.

exercises.explanation: Correct. These capabilities support comparison, controlled deployment, and safety.

feedback_for_incorrect.instructional: Place Foundry before the responsibilities it manages.

exercises.correct_answer: For each agent, Foundry manages message threads and tool execution.
exercises.explanation: Foundry is the subject that manages agent threads and tool execution.

exercises.question_text: Arrange the agentic-retrieval process in order.

feedback_for_incorrect.intrinsic: Later stages occur before their inputs exist.
feedback_for_incorrect.instructional: Decompose, search in parallel, then return cited results.

exercises.correct_answer: Break the question into subqueries search sources in parallel return cited results
exercises.explanation: Agentic retrieval decomposes first, searches next, and returns cited results last.

exercises.question_text: A clinical-assistance app must inspect a medical image, summarize accompanying text, and read the summary aloud. Which Foundry Tools fit? Select all that apply.

options.rationale: Azure Vision analyzes images. It addresses the medical-image requirement.
Azure Language can summarize text. It addresses the summary requirement.
Azure Speech can synthesize spoken output. It addresses the read-aloud requirement.
Agent orchestration coordinates task work. It does not itself provide image analysis, summarization, or speech synthesis.
options.better_fit: Choose this when coordinating an agent workflow.

feedback.intrinsic: The required AI functions remain absent.
feedback.instructional: Choose the tools that match each modality.

exercises.explanation: Correct. Vision, Language, and Speech cover the stated modalities.

exercises.question_text: Microsoft Foundry combines models, orchestration, monitoring, governance, and ___.

parts.text: Microsoft Foundry combines models, orchestration, monitoring, governance, and

feedback_for_incorrect.instructional: Foundry combines security with AI lifecycle capabilities.

exercises.explanation: Security is a core capability combined by Microsoft Foundry.

options.text: A permission-aware knowledge layer for agents
options.rationale: Foundry IQ is a permission-aware multi-source knowledge layer. It grounds agent answers in organization data.
Azure Vision analyzes images. Foundry IQ connects knowledge sources for grounded answers.

feedback.instructional: Use Vision for images and IQ for knowledge.

options.text: A task-oriented system that calls tools
options.rationale: An agent reasons, calls tools, and automates tasks. Foundry IQ provides knowledge that an agent can use.
options.better_fit: Choose this when defining an AI agent.

feedback.intrinsic: The knowledge layer is confused with a worker.
feedback.instructional: Agents act; IQ grounds their answers.

options.rationale: The catalog supports model selection and deployment. Foundry IQ supports knowledge grounding.
options.better_fit: Choose this when selecting or evaluating models.

feedback.intrinsic: The team would seek models instead of sources.
feedback.instructional: Keep model selection distinct from knowledge grounding.

exercises.explanation: Correct. Foundry IQ grounds agent answers using permitted knowledge.
